 <section class="elementor-section elementor-top-section elementor-element elementor-element-f8f22eb elementor-section-boxed elementor-section-height-default elementor-section-height-default" data-id="f8f22eb" data-element_type="section" data-e-type="section" data-settings="{&quot;jet_parallax_layout_list&quot;:[],&quot;background_background&quot;:&quot;classic&quot;}">
 <div class="elementor-container elementor-column-gap-default">
 <div class="elementor-column elementor-col-100 elementor-top-column elementor-element elementor-element-77b870a" data-id="77b870a" data-element_type="column" data-e-type="column">
 <div class="elementor-widget-wrap elementor-element-populated">
 <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-c602cc1 elementor-widget elementor-widget-heading" data-id="c602cc1" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="heading.default">
 <h2 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">Your Adventure Starts Here</h2> </div>
 <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-01cbb4a elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="01cbb4a" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
 The essence of FILHO DO VENTO experiences lies in the immersion into our world of nautical sports. From the best kitesurfing conditions, to Full Moon Canoe and Oyster Farm Excursions, its a place where kite, hotel &amp; community meet. </div>

Our Kitmaster School offers expert instruction to elevate your experience to the maximum. </div>

 <h2 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">Tours</h2> </div>
 <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-a33790f elementor-widget-divider--view-line elementor-widget elementor-widget-divider" data-id="a33790f" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="divider.default">

 Discover Pipa and its beauties with our diverse excursions, taking you to stunning beaches and lush trails. Whether you&#8217;re looking for adventure or cultural experiences, our meticulously planned itineraries are designed to please all tastes. Allow us to guide you through a memorable experience. </div>
